verdict.rationale: Alloy is an API-first identity and fraud platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question. The pack shows developer docs (Events API, webhooks, the /healthcheck endpoint, an SDK page and an llms.txt index). None of it documents an interactive, explorable API reference or runnable 'try it' examples. General API documentation is adjacent and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
